newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.002pts to 102.384.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.002pts to 102.384.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.002 points in Monday's trading to 102.384, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.384 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose by 0.042 points to 99.027 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.250 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 gained 3.588 points to 1,072.963.
